core_categories: Air Freight; Ocean Freight; Ground and Rail Transport; Contract Logistics; Finished Vehicle Logistics
specialty_focus: CEVA Logistics is a global supply chain and freight management company, operating as a subsidiary of the CMA CGM Group. It specializes in freight management and contract logistics, serving large and medium-sized national and multinational companies across more than 170 countries. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
